meta.name: Peace, Propaganda and The Promised Land
meta.description: By providing a striking comparison of US and international media coverage of the crisis in the Middle East,Peace, Propaganda and The Promised Landzeros in on how structural distortions in US media coverage have reinforced false perceptions of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict and how, through the use of language, framing and the context of the Israeli occupation of the West Bank and Gaza remains hidden in the news media…
